_README: Who may confirm a delivery in chat, and in which groups.
This file grants permission to release money, so it is version-controlled
and reviewed rather than editable from the web console -- the same rule
bound_chats: groups we listen to at all. Anything else is ignored, not
even buffered. Get a chat id by adding the bot to the group and
reading update.message.chat.id from getUpdates (group ids are negative).
confirmers: keyed 'platform:NUMERIC_USER_ID'. Never a display name or an
@username -- both are editable, and a released @username can be taken
by someone else, so keying on either would let anyone in the group
rename themselves into the warehouse manager. Get an id from
NEVER list a supplier here. An SME delivery group usually contains the
vendor, and a vendor confirming their own delivery is the conflict of
interest the three-way match exists to catch. Their confirmation still
gets recorded as evidence -- it just will not release payment by itself.
